address: 25 bis avenue de Loverchy, Annecy, 74000, France
bio: This dinky restaurant off the busy tourist trail is run by a couple of talented and versatile cooks with a passion for a Mediterranean fish called dentex. Together they craft flavoursome market-fresh cuisine that is in tune with the seasons, with a particular focus on fish, such as skrei with leek and preserved lemon. Places are limited, so be sure to book ahead!...
